status: Installed in Unity: eight map zones across World1/2; five original sprite sets retained
scope: Five world regions, three standalone one-cell platform variants per region

target.visualThicknessPx: 14–20px measured after uniform downscaling; approximately18px reference thickness
target.surface: narrow top lip with1–2px soft irregularity
target.collision: Existing top-only platform collision; no physics changes in this design pass

regions.name: 연필 숲
regions.detail: Region1 Pencil Forest hub. Warm muted taupe-gray compressed paper-earth strata with charcoal graphite seams, subtle thick rounded root fibers within underside. Use the FIRST warm paper cavern band of the material reference. Grounded ancient paper ledge, softened torn laminated edges. Keep broad asymmetric layers, no central knot/ring motif.
regions.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite design sheet for Unfinished Sketchbook, a serious atmospheric 2D side-view metroidvania. Create THREE standalone one-cell thin foothold platform variants stacked in three rows, on TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA background. Square sheet 1024x1024. Each platform occupies x64..960, centered at y210,512,814; each is 896px wide and approximately126px tall (7.1:1 wide/thin silhouette), ample clear space between. These become128px-wide ~18px-thick one-way footholds. Exact orthographic side view: walkable crest near horizontal with softly irregular bumps equivalent1-2px at final128px width, narrow top highlight equivalent2px, no visible broad top plane or perspective. Both ends rounded and finished, underside softly irregular, no support pillars. At least85% of width is walkable, do not make hanging islands or blocks. Three variations of same material, change the broad layering/erosion shapes rather than copy a giant repeating motif. Match the references' subdued matte textured relief and medium-large soft forms; simplified detail, no tiny scratched lines, no jagged shards, no pointed thorns, no pixel art, no photorealism, no thick cartoon outlines, no shiny3D look. Relatively readable upper rim, underside progressively darkens to near black while maintaining opaque material, outside transparent. No characters, floor scene, text, labels, borders, grids, shadows on background, floating debris, plant grass, or special-effect glow. Reference image1 is material/color context ONLY, not layout. Use the FIRST warm paper cavern band of the material reference. Grounded ancient paper ledge, softened torn laminated edges. Keep broad asymmetric layers, no central knot/ring motif.

regions.detail: Region2 Crayon Hills. Use RIGHT warm burnt umber/ochre crayon wax material from reference. regions.name: 색종이 도시
regions.detail: Region4 Folded Paper City. Use FOURTH weathered paper architecture region in reference. Thin shelf of folded laminated paper slabs, muted blue gray broad upper fold, small desaturated burgundy and parchment layer accents, charcoal underside. Corners softly worn, broad staggered folds without repetitive bricks or decorative miniature building. No spikes, hard metallic glossy edges or origami birds.
